$comment: Notes room of a work account (bipe ADR 0284 points 18 and 19, bipe-chat/bipe#1291, bipe-chat/bipe#1293). Each work account has one private, end-to-end encrypted notes room with only the account's own devices, like the drafts room (registries/drafts.json). Its room ID is in global account data accountDataType as {"room_id": ...}. The creating device sets the creation type roomType when its SDK can. A note is an m.room.message with msgtype m.text: body is the note text, and noteField holds {"room_id", "seat_id"?}: the customer chat it is about and the seat that wrote it. After a send to a customer, the sending device sends one m.room.message with msgtype m.notice, body replyByBody, and replyByField {"room_id", "event_id", "seat_id"}: inside the account, the apps show the name of that seat on that reply. Both are m.room.message because matrix-sdk-ui drops custom event types from the timeline (matrix-sdk-ffi 26.08.11). Customers see nothing of this room. A modified client can skip or fake these fields, so a name is a help, not proof. Rules: test-vectors/work-notes.json.
